messages:
Ravi (PM): quick sync - need final decision on "Burst cushion" + eviction policy for dedicated pools before Q3 roadmap. customers want deterministic behavior.
Mina (Eng): propose two-stage reclaim: gentle cushion reclaim first, then hard evict if needed. reduces churn and KV thrash.
Carlos (SRE): ops prefers naming: use 'cushion_pct' and 'hard_evict_threshold'. recommend cushion_pct=12, hard_evict_threshold=5.
Dana (Legal): require opt-out clause for automatic hard evictions and a notice window for preemptions longer than 30s. I'll draft language.
Sam (Product Ops): UX: console should show "Burst cushion" and "Eviction mode" with tooltip. default "graceful".
Mina (Eng): implementation sketch:
- graceful reclaim: decrement burst tokens, send reclaim signal, wait reclaim_wait_seconds (30s)
- hard evict: start draining/migration
Need migration API to preserve sticky sessions.
Ravi (PM): launch checklist draft:
- per-tenant eviction preference API
- tunable defaults per pool
- telemetry: cushion_usage_pct, graceful_reclaims, hard_evictions, migrate_fail_rate
- console UI + contract opt-out copy
- pilot with 3 customers (EU latency-critical, US bursty, APAC test)
Carlos (SRE): add alert when migrate_fail_rate > 1% for 5m; track p95 eviction latency.
Mina (Eng): config YAML sketch:
reserved_pools:
  default_cushion_pct: 12
  hard_evict_threshold_pct: 5
  reclaim_wait_seconds: 30
  eviction_mode: graceful  # graceful|immediate
  allow_auto_evict_by_default: false

Dana (Legal): clause note: "Customers may opt-out of automatic hard eviction via contract amendment; default product setting is auto-evict disabled for enterprise tiers." I'll circulate.
Sam (Product Ops): I'll source pilot candidates and prepare runbook. stage in canary pool first.
Mina (Eng): effort estimate: 5w dev (reclaim + migration API + console + tests). Carlos: 2w infra/dashboard/runbook.
Ravi (PM): target pilot kickoff in 7 weeks. action items: Mina RFC+PR, Carlos dashboard, Dana contract blurb, Sam pilot outreach. capacity-bot: created CAP-3371 assigned to @Mina.
Sam (Product Ops): small copy ask: show percent and hover explanation for reclaimed vs evicted.
Mina (Eng): add flag sticky_session_migration=true to reduce KV cold starts during migration, opt-in per tenant.
Ravi (PM): good. drop blockers here or DM me. :rocket:
